housing: Providence's rentals are largely triple-deckers and two-family wood houses, many built before 1978, plus student apartments near the colleges and lofts in old mills.

tenantHelp.name: Rhode Island Center for Justice
tenantHelp.what: legal help for tenants facing eviction or bad conditions (listed by RIHousing)

tenantHelp.name: City of Providence eviction defense program
tenantHelp.what: free eviction defense for low-income tenants with Rhode Island Legal Services

climate: Test the heating and look at windows and ceilings for drafts, leaks and ice-dam stains; winters are cold and snowy.
fact: Rhode Island landlords must list their rentals in a public statewide registry with a lead certificate, so Providence renters can look up their building.
